owned_inputs.binding: immutable satisfying assignment bound to the canonical R1CS digest, variable count, and public-input count
owned_inputs.r1cs_lifetime: sparse terms released after each lowered constraint; constraint array released before padding and copy-permutation construction
owned_inputs.assignment_lifetime: consumed by the checked prover and released after wire lowering and public-input extraction, before polynomial work

copy_permutation.algorithm: one encoded tail per wire; splice each new occurrence into the existing forward cycle in canonical row/column order
copy_permutation.dense_slot_count: R1CS variables including constant-one plus auxiliary wires
copy_permutation.sparse_fallback: BTreeMap of one tail per used wire when declared slots exceed three times the gate count

lower_bound_exclusions: prover workspace authentication indexes and extent metadata
full_fixture_capacity.basis: native payload minima for the witness-lowering and maximum-FFT stages; no full-pipeline allocation bound or peak-RSS measurement

benchmark.fixture: unchanged synthetic multiplication constraints; public test tau 29; nonzero wire and Z blinding
benchmark.srs_backend: authenticated uncompressed file SRS for every sample
benchmark.key_backend: authenticated file key for every sample
benchmark.workspace_backend: authenticated file workspace for every sample
benchmark.metric: requested live heap allocations; excludes allocator overhead, transient reallocation internals, stack, RSS and filesystem cache
benchmark.arithmetization_scope: starts with the materialized relation and assignment; owned mode includes assignment check and digest binding, borrowed mode defers that check to proving
benchmark.preprocessing_scope: all still-live inputs, SRS and gates/copy cells plus preprocessing buffers; excludes relation construction and SRS creation/import
benchmark.proving_scope: all still-live inputs, SRS, key and proving workspace; owned inputs are dropped at their documented phase boundaries
benchmark.timings: single sequential final runs on a shared host; background load and filesystem cache were not controlled

coverage: owned and borrowed gates, census, digest, copy cells, and lowered witness equality
invalid constant-one, assignment length, public/private values, and different-relation rejection
recovering a mutable witness consumes checked state and requires a new satisfaction check
dense and sparse copy cycles compared with an independent occurrence-list reference, including empty, singleton, repeated and mixed R1CS/auxiliary wires
copy builder count overflow and undeclared wire rejection
proof equality with memory/file keys and workspaces under zero and nonzero blinding
real-file SRS/key/workspace equality for compressed and uncompressed SRS encodings
existing proof corruption and I/O failure tests through all proof rounds
